programme.desc: Ainsley is in his kitchen inspired by the dishes from the pub menu—what beats a pint of ice-cold beer and a natter with your friends? The dishes available on the menu! Great British Bake-Off favourite Selasi Gbormittah joins him in the kitchen and shows Ainsley his sumptuous and indulgent Hazelnut Profiteroles. - The lovely Candice Brown shows her take on a bar snack classic, with a Ham Hock & Apple Scotch Egg. And Ainsley shows us his take on Cheesy Bean Nachos & Guacamole, and a Sensational Steak Sandwich with Blue Cheese Mayo to finish!

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s Glasgow show kicks off at music venue come restaurant Bloc where head chef Andy and front of house Pixie serve up a feast of calorific street food. Our hosts go all out to impress husband and wife team Luca and Magda of Italian restaurant Amore d’Italia, and Teddy and Michael of sushi and noodle soup chain Maki and Ramen. Twerking and live music keep the night lively, and the vegan starter goes well but the carbs pile up with the main and end with a dessert of over 2000 calories, which is a bit much for some!
